messages.subject: D-RUG this Thursday
messages.body_plain:
Hi D-RUGgies,

Somehow, it's August already.

We will be meeting this Thursday (8/7) from 10-noon virtually (zoom link <https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09>). This is a group working session so come with your questions for our expeRts, or just bring your laptop and get in some distraction free R-coding time. Additionally, if there are topics you would like to see someone do a deeper dive on, let us know!

Zoom https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz0 <https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09>

See you then,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
